rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jacob's deathbed question asks his sons what they will worship after him, and they affirm worship of one God and submission to Him.
rows.anchor: Benden sonra neye ibadet ve kulluk edeceksiniz?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jacob asked at his last breath to renew his earlier charge, modeling the duty to die as a Muslim for his children.
rows.anchor: son nefesinde bu suâli sormuş ve hakikaten İsrâil, Abdullah olduğunu ve İslâm üzere ölmek vasiyetinin numûnesini evlâdına göstermiş idi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: By naming Abraham and Ishmael among their forefathers, Jacob's sons show their Abrahamic kinship and that they are descendants of Abraham as well as Israel.
rows.anchor: Ya‘kūb’un dedesi İbrâhim’den ve amcası İsmâil’den başladılar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah's promised prophet like Moses from Israel's brothers is from Ishmael's descendants; Jacob's sons called Ishmael their father, while no such prophet came from Israel.
rows.anchor: Benî İsrâil’den böyle bir peygamber gelmemiştir. Ve bu sizden değil ihvânınızdan gelecektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Torah passage attributed to Moses foretells a prophet like him arising from among Israel's brothers, which Elmalılı identifies with the Ishmaelites.
rows.anchor: İlâhınız Rab teâlâ size aranızdan ve ihvânınızdan bana benzer bir nebî

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı reads Habakkuk's description of the Lord appearing from Sinai and holy Paran as a prophecy of Muhammad and his Companions, especially at Mecca's conquest.
rows.anchor: Allah Tûr-i Sînâ’dan, kudsî Cebel-i Fârân’dan geldi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Christian copies are also reported to read the final phrase as Muhammad appearing for his community's salvation and to redeem the Messiah.
rows.anchor: Nasârâ nüshalarında son fıkra

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı reads Isaiah's description of the distant-born visitors, pilgrimage, and Quraysh's sanctuary as referring to Mecca and its later prominence.
rows.anchor: Çünkü sen Ümmü’l-kurâ’sın. İmdi sâir bilâd evlâdı keenne Mekke’nin evlâdı

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He identifies the promised new praise with the Muslim talbiya after Mecca's conquest and contrasts it with the pagan formula that included a partner.
rows.anchor: ihdas olunan hamd de لَبَّيْكَ اَللّٰهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ

rows.speaker: Seman
rows.claim: Seman's Torah commentary reports God's promise to bless Ishmael, give him twelve princes, and make him the leader of a great nation; Elmalılı identifies that nation with Muhammad's community.
rows.anchor: Tevrat müfessirlerinden Seman Tevrat’ın sifr-i evvelinde şunu rivayet etmiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Greek Torah translation says Jacob told his sons that prophecy would continue among them until the coming messenger, after whom their prophecy and sovereignty would cease.
rows.anchor: Gelecek resul gelmediği müddetçe bizden nübüvvet munkatı‘olmaz, o geldikten sonra bizden nübüvvet ve saltanat munkatı‘olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Greek Psalm text predicts a future lawgiving prophet whose light reaches east and west, whose first followers are Arabs, and whose enduring law is obeyed by rulers.
rows.anchor: Yani Hak teâlâ vahiy tarîkiyle Dâvûd’a buyurdu ki

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Gospel saying attributed to Jesus describes a later figure who existed before Jesus and whose sandal strap Jesus is unworthy to untie.
rows.anchor: benden evvel halk olunmuştur. Ben onun papucu bağını çözmek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus's Paraclete saying describes a messenger who speaks only what is revealed; Elmalılı links this to Quranic statements that Muhammad follows revelation rather than personal desire.
rows.anchor: Ben gideceğim ve size Faraklit Rûhu’l-hak gelecektir ki kendi tarafından tekellüm etmez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One interpretation takes Faraklit to mean an intercessor who is interceded for, a quality of the Messenger.
rows.anchor: Birisi, şâfi‘müşeffa‘demektir ki Resûlullah’ın bir sıfatıdır

rows.speaker: Nasârâ
rows.claim: Some Christians explain Faraklit as the separator of truth and falsehood, deriving it from Faruk with a Greek intensifying suffix; Elmalılı says this also names the Prophet as possessor of the criterion.
rows.anchor: İkincisi, bazı Nasârâ demişler ki “Faraklit”

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı condemns the Christians' refusal to understand these scriptural signs as sheer error.
rows.anchor: Ve Nasârânın bu âyetleri anlamak istememeleri

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Elmalılı argues that the old scriptures preserve prophecies of Muhammad whose meanings Jews and Christians hide or distort, and that the Quran confirms them; their combined force removes doubt for fair readers.
rows.anchor: bunlar hakkıyla okuyanlar ve cüz’î fehm ve insâfı olanlar için bilhassa hey’et-i mecmû‘asıyla her türlü şüpheyi kesmeye kâfî beyyinâttır

rows.speaker: İbn Abbas
rows.claim: A report from Ibn Abbas says the Torah promised an unlettered prophet from Ishmael; those who follow and affirm his light receive forgiveness, Paradise, and two rewards for following Moses and Muhammad.
rows.anchor: İbn Abbas hazretlerinden rivayet olunduğu üzere Cenâb-ı Allah Tevrat’ta Benî İsrâil’e şöyle bir ahd

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another transmitted Torah description gives the final Prophet's birthplace as Mecca, home as Tayba, realm as Syria, and community as Hammādūn.
rows.anchor: “mevlidi Mekke’de, meskeni Taybe’de, mülkü Şâm’da ve ümmeti Hammâdûn” diye

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The earlier communities were promised a future culminating Prophet and were required to believe in him before his arrival, accepting God's covenant in each revealed book.
rows.anchor: Bâlâda nakledilen ve elyevm mevcud bulunan kütüb-i sâlife âyetleri de kat‘iyyen gösteriyor ki Cenâb-ı Allah öteden beri

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mosaic religion is not the beginning and Christianity is not the final dispensation: Jesus was not the prophet like Moses, and the Gospel itself announced a later possessor of the criterion and spirit of truth.
rows.anchor: Tevrat mûcebince Mûsâ’ya benzeyen

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's first address to the Israelites demands that they fulfil their covenant and believe the revelation confirming what they already possess.
rows.anchor: emirleriyle bu ahdin icrâ-yı îcâbını talep etmiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Abraham story and Jacob's testament clarify the meaning of Israel's brothers and the value of Islam.
rows.anchor: kıssa-i İbrâhim’deki kelimâta ve vasiyyet-i Ya‘kūb’a nazar-ı dikkati celb ederek ihvânın mânasını, İslâmın kıymetini tefhim

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse condemns Jewish scholars who conceal God's revealed scripture or its rulings and falsify truth to gain money, goods, or status in this world.
rows.anchor: Allah’ın inzal buyurduğu kitâbı -ahbâr-ı Yehûdun yaptığı gibi- ketm edenler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their worldly gains become fire in their bellies: every deed contrary to God's law contains a spiritual spark of fire, especially trade gained by concealing revelation.
rows.anchor: karınları dolusu ateşten başka bir şey yemezler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's refusal to speak to them means withholding merciful regard because they concealed God's speech, in accord with requiting evil with its like.
rows.anchor: Bunlar ise Allah’ın kelâmını ketm ettiklerinden âhirette kelâm-ı rahmetten mahrum kalacaklardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will not cleanse them or grant forgiveness as He does believers, but will raise them in their impurity for lasting painful punishment.
rows.anchor: oldukları gibi bütün mülevveslikleriyle haşr eyleyecektir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The concealers exchanged guidance for error and forgiveness for punishment, so misguidance and torment became their lasting acquired possession.
rows.anchor: dalâlet ve azab onların ebedî milk-i müktesebleri olmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The exclamation about their patience before the Fire is divine sarcasm: they could not sacrifice worldly pleasure for good, yet persist in deeds that lead to eternal burning and helpless ruin.
rows.anchor: ateşe karşı ne sabırlı şeyler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The punishment is just because God sent the whole class of scripture with and proclaiming truth; those who deny or conceal it deserve the Fire.
rows.anchor: Allah, cins-i kitâbını şüphesiz hak ile, hakka mülâbis, hakkı nâtık olarak indirdi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People who reject some revealed books, or accept only selected parts of one book, remain far from truth in schism and deserve lasting punishment.
rows.anchor: kitapta ihtilâf edenler, Allah’ın indirdiği kitapların hepsine inanmayıp da kimi Tevrat’a, kimi İncil’e inananlar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Communities without a true revealed book as their common authority cannot escape dispute, and selective readings shaped by personal desire multiply conflict and destroy society.
rows.anchor: Beynlerinde ma‘mûlün bih ve ihtilâf ettikleri zaman hakem ittihaz edilecek bir kitâb-ı hakka iman etmemiş olanlar, nizâ‘vü şikāktan kurtulamayacakları gibi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sincere differences of understanding among people who seek truth in good faith do not break their underlying unity or amount to grave schism.
rows.anchor: hüsn-i niyet ve kemâl-i hakkāniyetle anlamaya çalıştıkları hâlde hasbe’l-beşeriyye fehmleri ihtilâf edenlerin ise vahdet-i asliyelerine halel gelmez

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Scholarly disagreement reached through full effort and sound legal reasoning, without aiming to create discord, is excused and may even be a mercy that eases practice, as a hadith indicates.
rows.anchor: ihtilâfât ise ihdâs-ı hilâfı gaye edinmemek şartıyla muâf ve hattâ bir hadiste işaret buyurulduğu üzere teysîr ve tevsî‘nokta-i nazarından vesîle-i rahmet de olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person in urgent difficulty may act on one disputed legal opinion, but public rulings should seek common ground; issuing them without that search contradicts the emblem of unity and the verse's warning.
rows.anchor: ictimâ‘î hususlarda cihet-i ittifak taharrî edilmeden kıl kavli ile iftâ edilmesi şi‘âr-ı tevhîde münâfî

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning applies especially to writers, teachers, and educators: named Jewish leaders concealed Muhammad's descriptions and other rulings for gifts, a moral lesson for Muslims too.
rows.anchor: Kâ‘b b. Eşref, Kâ‘b b. Esed, Mâlik b. Sayf, Huyey b. Ahtab ve Ebû Yâsir b. Ahtab gibi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Talut tests his troops at a river: whoever drinks is excluded, while one who refrains belongs to him, except for a permitted handful taken by hand.
rows.anchor: ancak eliyle bir avuç alan içlerinden müstesnâ, bu kadarına ruhsat var

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Talut's order allowed only a handful and specifically forbade drinking by putting one's mouth directly to the water.
rows.anchor: Doğrudan doğru ağızla sömürmeye müsaade yok

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When the army reached the river, all but a few drank despite Talut's instruction.
rows.anchor: ırmağa gelince askerin birazından mâ‘adâsı hep ondan içtiler, emri dinlemediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A report says one man took a handful sufficient for himself and his animal, while those who gulped the river developed purple lips and greater fever and collapsed behind.
rows.anchor: bir avuç alır kendine ve hayvanına kifayet edermiş, fakat saldırıp içenlerin dudakları morarır, harâretleri artarmış

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The claim that the army lacked strength against Goliath may be the words of those left behind, or of weaker believers who crossed but lost heart at the enemy's numbers; believers differed in faith.
rows.anchor: Yahut bunlar değil de nehri geçmiş mü’minlerin zayıf kısmı düşmanın çokluğunu görünce ümitsizliğe düşüp birbirlerine böyle söylediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those certain of meeting God know death cannot be avoided, stand firm in their pledge, and resolve to be either martyrs or victors, so they encourage the weak.
rows.anchor: bugün bu muharebede ölmezse diğer bir gün behemehâl öleceklerini ve nihâyet huzûr-ı ilâhîye varacaklarını bilen

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The faithful answer that many small companies have defeated much larger ones by God's permission and that God is with the steadfast.
rows.anchor: nice kereler azıcık bir bölük birçok bölüklere bi-iznillâh galebe çaldılar

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Facing Goliath's army, the believers collectively ask God to pour patience upon them, keep their feet firm and their resolve steady, and grant victory over the unbelievers.
rows.anchor: ayaklarımızı denk ve yerinde tut, titretme, kaydırma, azm ü hedefimizden şaşırtma

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: With God's permission the believers rout the enemy and David kills Goliath; God grants David kingship, wisdom, and prophethood, and Saul gives him his daughter.
rows.anchor: Tâlût kendisine kızını vermiş ve bilâhare arz-ı mukaddesin meşârık

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God teaches David further skills, including softening iron to make armor, understanding birds, and fine melodies; a small faithful minority's resolve and prayer can bring great unexpected success.
rows.anchor: demirleri yumuşatıp zırhlı elbiseler yapmak sanatını ve başkalarının bilmediği kuş dilini

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Without God countering some people through others, aggressors would destroy cultivation, offspring, learning, craft, religion, and faith; resistance preserves society and its vulnerable people.
rows.anchor: Allah insanların bazısını bazısıyla def‘veya müdafaa etmemiş, müfsid ve mütecâvizleri muslih ve mücâhidlerle def‘ve ehl-i silm ü salâhı ve evlâd u nisvânı vikāye etmemiş olsa idi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God wills flourishing and righteousness, the righteous must repel corruption; resistance is a just law throughout creation and humans must apply it through reason, will, and faith.
rows.anchor: Binâen‘aleyh salâhın fesâdı def‘etmesi için ehl-i salâh ü hayrın ehl-i fesâd ü şerri def‘etmesi lâzımdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God made war and government lawful to protect the righteous from aggressors; failing to defend them lets oppressors seize power and makes their enablers responsible for the resulting ruin.
rows.anchor: Allah harbi ve hükûmeti bu hikmetle meşrû kılmış ve insanların müfsid ve mütecâviz kısmını muslih kısmıyla def‘ve hüsn-i sûretle çalışacakları vikāye için emretmiştir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: There are wars for reform and wars for corruption; believers are commanded to wage reform in God's path against oppression, corruption, disbelief, and idolatry, securing universal peace.
rows.anchor: iki harb vardır. Birisi harb-i ıslah, diğeri harb-i ifsaddır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The narrated stories, through the episode of David, are God's true signs, free of distortion, and confirm that Muhammad is one of the messengers.
rows.anchor: biz bunları sana her türlü reyb ü hatâdan, şâibe-i tahrîf ü galattan ‘ârî mahz-ı hakk u hakīkat olarak tilâvet ediyoruz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse's readings differ on the forms of an tadilla and fa-tudhakkira; Hamza reads with the hamza's kasra, while Ibn Kathir, Abu Amr, and Yaqub use a still zā and an ungeminated kāf.
rows.anchor: Hamza kıraatinde hemzenin kesriyle فَتُذَكِّرَ;أَن تَضِلَّ İbn Kesîr, Ebû Amr, Ya‘kūb kıraatlerinde zâl’in sükûnu

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Hamza also reads the relevant form with rāʾ in the nominative, whereas readings other than Asim's use the nominative for wa-la yudārra.
rows.anchor: Hamza kıraatinde de râ’nın zammıyla تِجَٰرَةً حَاضِرَةًۭ;فَتُذَكِّرَ Âsım kıraatinden mâ‘adâsında ref‘ile

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abu Jaafar reads tijāratan hāḍiratan with an ungeminated rāʾ; Ibn Kathir and Abu Amr read furuhun with both rāʾ and hāʾ vocalized and without the alif.
rows.anchor: râ ve he’nin zammıyla elifsiz فَرُهُنٌ okunur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Called the Verse of Debt, this is the Quran's longest verse.
rows.anchor: Bu birinci âyete “Âyet-i Müdâyene” tâbir olunur ki Kur’an’da en uzun âyet budur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One report gives the occasion of revelation as salam, paying in advance for goods delivered later, though the ruling covers every kind of sale and debt transaction.
rows.anchor: Bir rivayette sebeb-i nüzûlü selem, yani peşin semen ile veresi mal almak ise de

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Linguists distinguish a loan from debt, so the verse's condition need not cover a pure loan; jurisprudence treats a loan first as a trust and finally as a currency exchange, with no fixed repayment date.
rows.anchor: “karz”, “deyn”in gayrıdır. Binâen‘aleyh bu âyetteki şart

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Any debt transaction with a specified, known due date should be written; credit trading remains permissible despite the ban on usury, provided the due date is known and documented.
rows.anchor: Borçlaşabilirsiniz, fakat alışverişte borcun vadesi mâlum olmalı, bir de yazılarak tevsik edilmelidir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A neutral scribe should record both parties' rights equally; parties may keep private records, but those do not replace the impartial written contract.
rows.anchor: tarafeynden hiçbirine meyl etmeyecek, ‘ale’s-seviyye iki tarafın da hukūkunu olduğu gibi gözeterek yazabilecek bîtaraf bir kâtib-i adl aranızda yazsın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A scribe must write as God taught, following proper documentary practice, justice, or gratitude for the gift of literacy; writing is a collective duty that becomes an individual duty when assigned.
rows.anchor: Bunu yazmak farz-ı kifâyedir, ta‘ayyün edince farz-ı ‘ayn olur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Appointing legal document scribes is among the government's duties, and such scribes must write when asked.
rows.anchor: hükûmetin kâtib-i vesâik, ta‘bîr-i âharla kâtib-i adl tâyin etmesi de vezâifindendir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The debtor dictates the note because its contents constitute the debtor's acknowledgment and the witness statement is against that party.
rows.anchor: Çünkü yazılacak senedin mazmûnu onun ikrârı bulunacak, şehadet de onun aleyhine olacaktır
